apps.name: Tasks
apps.summary: A short to-do list, not a system. Add, check off, clear.
apps.description:
Tasks is a plain to-do list. No projects, no labels, no productivity system to maintain, just today’s list and whatever’s still open from before.

Nothing rolls over automatically and nothing nags you. What’s left at the end of the day is still there tomorrow, exactly where you left it.

Private and secure by default: no Google services, no trackers, no accounts required.

howItWorks.title: Add
howItWorks.text: Type a task and it’s on the list. No due date or project to assign.

howItWorks.title: Check
howItWorks.text: Tap to mark something done. It stays visible, struck through, until you clear it.

howItWorks.title: Clear
howItWorks.text: Clear finished tasks whenever you want a fresh list.

screenshots.title: Today’s list
screenshots.caption: Everything open right now, in the order you added it

screenshots.title: Done
screenshots.caption: What you’ve already checked off, kept until you clear it

screenshots.title: Add
screenshots.caption: Type a task and it’s on the list
